name: Stability Ball Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Kneel near a wall with the stability ball in front of you and one hand on the wall for balance.
Place one foot on top of the ball and gently tuck your pelvis, keeping your torso upright.
Shift forward just enough to feel a stretch across the front of the kneeling hip.
Hold the stretch, then ease back and switch legs.
tips: Steady the ball with your front foot before shifting forward.
Gently tighten the rear glute to keep your lower back from arching.
